description.value: The Quesnel Branch of the Cariboo Regional District Library is a publicly accessible branch library operated by the Cariboo Regional District, serving Quesnel and the surrounding central interior. Part of a 15-branch regional network, it hosts regular community programming including book clubs, craft clubs, chess clubs, and author events. Located in downtown Quesnel, it sits along a key hub town on the interior touring corridor between Prince George and Williams Lake.
